thread.listingTitle: Shower inside the room at Surfers Paradise, Gold Coast

messages.text:
Hiii Jess! my name is Aisha im 20 years old and currently a student at the University of Queensland 😊
im in Sydney at the moment finishing up an internship and will be heading back for uni in 2 days so im looking for a place as soon as possible. I came across your listing and it looks so lovely so i wanted to ask if the room is still available
im clean tidy and super respectful of shared spaces!
thank you so much and hope to hear from you soon 🤍
And is it possible if i do inspection for tomorrow?
Hii Jess!! just checking in 😊 I’m very interested and ready to move in straight away after inspection if it’s still available!

Hi! We're doing inspections next Thursday at 1pm.
Would you like to come?
📍 4/44 Watson Esplanade, Surfers Paradise QLD 4217
Mathis will be there to assist you.
Message when you arrive: +61 411 590 261
